entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: He's totally out of his mind! I'm gonna[n]have to pose nude if this keeps up!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: How dare that Yusuke...!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: The way he said it, it's not gonna be semi,[n]but full-on nude...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: F-Fu— F-F-Full nudity? Lady Ann's gonna...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Drop it!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You know, you won't have to worry about[n]that if we make Madarame confess before[n]the exhibit ends.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But Kitagawa-kun thinks he owes his life[n]to him. Is there a need to make Madarame[n]confess?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Then, Lady Ann... you're fine with baring[n]it all!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I am not!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Madarame's no different from Kamoshida.[n]That asshole's usin' Yusuke, who doesn't[n]have parents.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You're tellin' me we should just ignore[n]how he's bein' treated horribly like the[n]other pupils?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: No... It is frustrating to leave this alone,[n]even if Kitagawa-kun is fine with it[n]himself...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You can't leave it be because you've[n]endured a lot yourself, with Kamoshida.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...Yeah.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Anyways, we gotta go after this guy.[n]Madarame's the kind of target we've[n]been waitin' for.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Let's help Yusuke come to his senses[n]too... before he ends up like us.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...Right.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We need to look into Madarame first.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: There might be tons more stuff that[n]hasn't been exposed yet, too.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It may become easier for us to investigate[n]his Palace if he's preoccupied with his[n]exhibit.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Also, there's the thing about me[n]modeling!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Kitagawa-kun said there'd be[n]"inconveniences" unless he submits[n]a new piece.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Maybe that's going to be announced soon[n]as Madarame's next work...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: No way! Hell no!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oh yeah. It might not show your face.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: That doesn't make me feel any better[n]about it!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: What, are you saying I'm— No, I mean—[n]That's not what this is about!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We must deal with Madarame, no matter[n]what, before his exhibit ends!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Let's start after school tomorrow.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It'll be a pain if Miss President finds us on[n]the rooftop again, so where to meet up...[n]Let's see...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I guess that walkway-like place in Shibuya[n]would work. It's near Madarame's place,[n]too.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...Changing our hideout periodically,[n]huh? That's a plan I don't mind backing.
Your hideout has moved from the[n]Shujin Academy Rooftop to the[n][clr 2]Shibuya Teikyu Building Accessway[clr 27].

entries.speaker: Woman with Camera
entries.en: Hey, can I talk to you kids for a sec?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...Huh?

entries.speaker: Woman with Camera
entries.en: From the looks of things, you don't seem[n]like the ordinary, stalking fans.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Uh...

entries.speaker: Woman with Camera
entries.en: Oh, sorry. I should've been more clear.[n]I'm actually looking for people that know[n]Madarame's pupils.

entries.speaker: Woman with Camera
entries.en: There's this painting, "Sayuri," that was[n]supposedly stolen in the past.

entries.speaker: Woman with Camera
entries.en: But there's this rumor that it was taken[n]by one of his pupils in retaliation for[n]being abused.

entries.speaker: Woman with Camera
entries.en: Have you heard anything about that?
We don't care about art.
Ryuji knows.

entries.speaker: Woman with Camera
entries.en: I see...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Me!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I don't know nothing!

entries.speaker: Woman with Camera
entries.en: I see...

entries.speaker: Woman with Camera
entries.en: There's no case unless there's a victim,[n]and if there's no proof of abuse... I can't[n]write either.

entries.speaker: Woman with Camera
entries.en: Looks like I'm back to square one.[n]Sorry for taking your time.

entries.speaker: Woman with Camera
entries.en: I'm a journalist. If you ever get any leads,[n]mind contacting me here?

entries.speaker: Woman with Camera
entries.en: See you then.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...I guess we should go home for today.
